entities.name: Public control room remains a truthful projection
entities.summary: An installable public PWA can expose allowlisted accepted project state with exact provenance and visible freshness without owning semantic truth.

entities.name: Public projection safety gate
entities.summary: Rejects invalid, non-allowlisted, unbound, stale-as-live, or partially generated public artifacts.

entities.name: Control Room GitHub Pages deployment

entities.name: Deliver the Semantic Systems Control Room PWA
entities.summary: Build, review, and publish the public-safe phone-first project projection under design spec 0006.

acceptance: Public snapshot is deterministic, allowlisted, and bound to an exact commit
Phone views expose systems, semantics, evidence, work, and freshness
Offline and stale state are visibly distinct from current state
Default GitHub Pages deployment passes public payload and browser checks
Custom domain is verified or remains an explicit external blocker

relations.summary: Implementation depends on the completed read-only explorer query contract.
The tracer delivers the first public-safe explorer realization.
The explorer is published only as a derived read-only snapshot.
The export, privacy, PWA, and deployed probes authorize publication.
The gate evaluates the bounded project claim without upgrading its evidence categories.
